title: MCPHallu: Benchmarking Reasoning, Execution, and Memory Hallucinations in MCP Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.07689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), which allows them to discover and invoke tools across multiple servers at runtime. Existing MCP benchmarks primarily measure task completion; where they diagnose failures, they do so after execution rather than building specific reasoning, execution, and memory failure risks into task construction.   We introduce MCPHallu, a benchmark for diagnosing hallucination-prone agent failures in MCP environments along three axes: reasoning, execution, and memory. MCPHallu contains 358 tasks across five capability domains and runs on 36 production MCP servers in isolated containers. Each task is designed with a structural trigger that makes one of four subtypes the dominant failure risk: Branch Collapse, Unreachable Goal, Tool Misuse, or Context Forgetting. translated_title: MCPHallu：面向MCP智能体的推理、执行与记忆幻觉基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体正越来越多地通过模型上下文协议进行部署，该协议使智能体能够在运行时发现并调用跨多个服务器的工具。现有的MCP基准主要衡量任务完成情况；即使它们对失败进行诊断，也是在执行之后才进行，而非将特定的推理、执行和记忆失败风险内置到任务构建之中。我们提出了MCPHallu，这是一个沿推理、执行和记忆三个维度诊断MCP环境中智能体易产生幻觉失败的基准。MCPHallu包含跨五个能力领域的358个任务，并在隔离容器中的36个生产级MCP服务器上运行。每个任务都设计有结构性触发器，使四种失败子类型之一成为主导失败风险：分支坍缩、不可达目标、工具误用或上下文遗忘。这一设计使子类型级别的分析成为可能，而不仅仅依赖聚合的任务成功率。我们评估……
tldr: 该论文提出MCPHallu基准，通过在358个任务中内置结构性触发器，沿推理、执行与记忆三个维度，在36个生产级MCP服务器上实现对四种幻觉失败子类型（分支坍缩、不可达目标、工具误用、上下文遗忘）的子类型级诊断。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MCPHallu, a benchmark that embeds structural triggers into 358 tasks across reasoning, execution, and memory axes, enabling subtype-level diagnosis of four hallucination failure subtypes (Branch Collapse, Unreachable Goal, Tool Misuse, and Context Forgetting) in MCP agents on 36 production MCP servers.
